en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ivy‑covered Neo‑Gothic/Tudor villa with crenellations, arched mullioned windows, a round turret, a balustrade with a small statue and stone steps. Printed caption below reads that it is the Feudal Art Museum "Ing. D. F. Minovici" in Bucharest. The reverse side has Romanian printed text of the era and a handwritten New Year greeting dated 1963.
